The artifact severity is moderate; the image looks like a noisy photo, but the text and edge softness betray its AI origin.

It is a convincing visual approximation but fails the functional detail test.
artifact_reasoning: Primary artifacts are text gibberish (illegible handwriting) and slight structural softness/melting at the internal window edges.
